conclusion: Eli Stone is responsible for the theft of the laboratory prototype. Visual evidence (V04) shows a person in an orange coat (Eli's assigned color per case brief) in possession of the prototype at the Service Door. After applying the +5 minute clock offset correction documented in D03 and V10, the actual time of this observation is 18:14 - within the theft window between 18:00 (V02, prototype present) and 18:18 (V05, prototype missing). Eli's statement claiming he did not approach the lab after 18:00 is directly contradicted by this evidence. The Service Corridor provides unmonitored access to the lab (V01), enabling the theft without triggering main cameras. Eli also expressed prior motive in D03 ('My project needs that prototype tomorrow' at 17:00).
